text:
emily-partners: Heads-up: Datadog SI partner wants a joint demo for the marketplace listing. They asked for an "observability play" showing GPU traces, model routing fallback, and a quick how-to for customers. Can we run through what needs to be ready?

rafael-eng: I'll own dashboard changes. Need to confirm which trace attributes to expose so DD's tiles can auto-label by model & tier. Also want a smoother visual for token latency (current token-by-token makes the demo look jittery).

nina-datadog: Great. We can consume OTLP traces with resource attributes. Recommend these fields: resource.service.name, resource.attributes.model_name, resource.attributes.model_variant, otel.span.duration_ms, redwood.customer_tier. We'll send a collector snippet.

nina-datadog: Collector example to map resource attributes -> datadog tags (drop into your otel-collector):

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: resource.attributes.model_name
        action: upsert
        new_key: dd.tag.model_name
      - key: resource.attributes.model_variant
        action: upsert
        new_key: dd.tag.model_variant
      - key: redwood.customer_tier
        action: upsert
        new_key: dd.tag.customer_tier
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

rafael-eng: Perfect. On our side I'll add a derived metric avg_token_ms_per_model and a 30s rolling average graph so the demo looks stable. Also adding a legend that auto-populates from dd.tag.model_variant.

jasper-ops: For the fallback scenario we should simulate a capacity pressure event so traffic routes to the cheaper instance. I'll prepare a script that toggles the routing flag and emits a synthetic trace tagged with redwood.customer_tier=fallback.

emily-partners: Nice. Marketing needs the recorded walkthrough + a 45s teaser and a 20s cut for the marketplace carousel. Target: have recording by Tue 04/05 so legal has time to review.

tessa-marketing: Can we get the recording by Mon 04/04 AM? We want one day to edit. Also need marketplace screenshots: dashboard overview + trace flame lane. Use white bg PNGs.

nina-datadog: We'll upload partner logo SVGs and a 1200x628 banner to the joint drive: https://drive.datadog.partners/redwood-sis.

legal-bot: Reminder: partner quotes and any co-branded text must be approved. @emily-partners please submit the proposed partner blurb for review. Legal turnaround ~24-48h.

emily-partners: Will do. I'll post the draft here by EOD today.

rafael-eng: CI note: I'm pushing a dashboard JSON to the repo. If someone can run the demo infra job after that I'll kick off a synthetic run.

ci-bot: CI job queued: integrations/si-marketplace-demo #5099. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/integrations/5099/artifacts. ETA ~8m.

emily-partners: Action items recap: Rafael update dashboard + derived metrics (due Sat), Jasper create fallback generator script (due Sat), Nina provide collector snippet + assets (done), Tessa edit cuts after recording, Legal to approve blurb. Recording target Mon AM. Ping here if you need help. :rocket:

rafael-eng: I'll also export a "demo-only" dashboard with synthetic widgets under dashboards/_demo so marketing can screenshot without live data.

tessa-marketing: Love that. Makes screenshots predictable.

emily-partners: Closing loop 1: embargo until both legal sign-off and Datadog confirms go-live. Don't post anything public until I confirm.

nina-datadog: Ack. We'll hold until you give the green light.

rafael-eng: ack.
